offers.description: Find timestamped changes across released evidence dimensions for a resolved property since a caller-supplied timestamp, with deterministic change fingerprints, source-snapshot digests, per-source observational summaries, explicit timestamp semantics, source gaps, and a machine-readable next-check contract for repeat polling.

description: Paid $0.03 USD. Find timestamped changes after an ISO 8601 since value across released evidence dimensions for a resolved property, currently comprehensive in San Francisco. Use this for repeat polling; use check_permits for current permit detail or build_property_intelligence_pack for a full current snapshot. Unsupported or held jurisdictions fail before payment.

inputSchema.description: Repeat-poll one resolved property for supported changes after a caller-supplied observation time.

address.description: Street address or place to research. Include locality information when available.

city.description: Optional city used to disambiguate the address and route it to a supported LocalProof jurisdiction.

since.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time. LocalProof returns supported changes observed after this instant; the value cannot be in the future.

state.description: Optional state name or abbreviation. Current released jurisdictions are in California; use CA or California.

unit.description: Optional unit, suite, or apartment identifier when it is relevant to property identity.

name: localproof.check_property_changes
title: Check Property Changes
